model_meta.description: A vibration isolator combining elastic mechanical isolation with fluid chambers and a reciprocating orifice control member.
model_meta.domain: mechanical vibration isolation and fluid damping

subsystems.description: First and second members connect respectively to vibration generation and vibration reception portions.
functional_basis: connect respective mounting members to generation and reception portions

subsystems.description: Disposed between mounting members; deforms elastically and forms part of the main chamber partition wall.
Fluid-filled chamber whose volume changes with deformation of the elastic element.
Fluid-filled chamber with at least a portion of its partition wall deformably formed.
Provides fluid communication between main and sub-chambers; a portion may be opened or closed by the reciprocating member.
Reciprocates to open and close a portion of the orifice; an opposed abutting portion contacts the elastic valve body.
Valve body and valve seat provide one-way fluid flow from the opening-member side toward the main chamber; valve body is elastic.
Biases the opening and closing member away from the check valve.
Central shaft and bearing guide the opening and closing member; claims describe alternative placements on the member, orifice-forming member, or partition member.

item_flows.name: Chamber fluid through orifice
item_flows.notes: Fluid communicates between main chamber and sub-chamber through the orifice; opening/closing member changes whether part of the path is open.

item_flows.name: Vibration transmission toward reception portion
item_flows.notes: Mechanical interaction: vibration transmitted from the vibration-generation portion connected to either mounting member deforms the elastic element; this reduces vibration and makes transmission to the vibration-reception portion connected to the other mounting member difficult.

requirements.statement: Check valve permits fluid flow only from the opening and closing member side toward the main fluid chamber.
Guide member guides reciprocating motion of the opening and closing member.
Opening and closing member includes an abutting portion capable of contacting the elastic check-valve body when brought close.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; claim 2 specifies protrusion toward valve body.

actions.name: Deform elastic element and change chamber volume

steps.description: Vibration transmitted from the vibration-generation portion connected to either mounting member elastically deforms the elastic element between the mounting members and is thereby reduced, making transmission to the vibration-reception portion connected to the other mounting member difficult.
Deformation changes the internal volume of the main fluid chamber.
Shaft and bearing constrain the opening and closing member's reciprocating motion.
Elastic member biases the opening and closing member in a direction away from the check valve.
Check valve permits flow from the opening-member side only toward the main fluid chamber.
When brought close to the valve body, the opposed abutting portion contacts the elastic valve body.
Elastic deformation of the element absorbs vibration and makes transmission to the vibration-reception portion connected to the other mounting member difficult.
